title: Shared data and the page
summary: A view (the HTML template of a page or component) reads `client/shared/data/<name>.json` as `data.<name>`. It reads the path of its document as `page.path`. It reads whether it runs in development mode as `page.development`. No service (a class that holds the state and behavior of a view) is needed (ADR 0036). Put content that has no behavior in these data files, not in a service. If the file is missing, the build fails with `TY1311`. No service may use `data` or `page` as its instance name.
